import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the gsl_function structure
class GSLFunction(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("function", ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double)),
        ("params", ctypes.c_void_p)
    ]

# Define the Python wrapper for gsl_integration_qk41
def integrate_qk41(func, a, b):
    # Create a GSL function wrapper
    gsl_func = GSLFunction()
    gsl_func.function = ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double)(func)
    gsl_func.params = None

    # Prepare output variables
    result = ctypes.c_double()
    abserr = ctypes.c_double()
    resabs = ctypes.c_double()
    resasc = ctypes.c_double()

    # Call the gsl_integration_qk41 function
    gsl.gsl_integration_qk41(
        ctypes.byref(gsl_func),
        ctypes.c_double(a),
        ctypes.c_double(b),
        ctypes.byref(result),
        ctypes.byref(abserr),
        ctypes.byref(resabs),
        ctypes.byref(resasc)
    )

    return result.value, abserr.value, resabs.value, resasc.value

# Test cases
def assert_test():
    # Define a sample function to integrate
    def sample_function(x):
        return np.sin(x)

    # Test case 1: Integrate sin(x) over [0, pi]
    result, abserr, resabs, resasc = integrate_qk41(sample_function, 0, np.pi)
    assert np.isclose(result, 2.0, atol=1e-6), f"Expected 2.0, got {result}"
    assert abserr < 1e-6, f"Unexpected absolute error: {abserr}"

    # Test case 2: Integrate sin(x) over [0, pi/2]
    result, abserr, resabs, resasc = integrate_qk41(sample_function, 0, np.pi / 2)
    assert np.isclose(result, 1.0, atol=1e-6), f"Expected 1.0, got {result}"
    assert abserr < 1e-6, f"Unexpected absolute error: {abserr}"

    # Test case 3: Integrate sin(x) over [pi/2, pi]
    result, abserr, resabs, resasc = integrate_qk41(sample_function, np.pi / 2, np.pi)
    assert np.isclose(result, 1.0, atol=1e-6), f"Expected 1.0, got {result}"
    assert abserr < 1e-6, f"Unexpected absolute error: {abserr}"

    print("All tests passed.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
